purpose: Introduction source verification and bibliography expansion
limits: This is a scoped narrative review, not an exhaustive systematic review.
An abstract or indexed section does not establish the absence of a mechanism in a full paper.
Preprints remain identified as preprints. Existing full-text library grades are not upgraded by abstract checks.
DC17 model descriptions refer to arXiv:2510.25118v1; journal metadata do not establish manuscript identity.
CFE03 is cited for procurement analysis, not as evidence of a strict one-hour implementation.
CFE02 emissions accounting and DC21 physical supply are not equated to CFE attribute accounting.
